features.sectionDescription: Our platform bridges the gap between rural communities and quality healthcare through modern technology and AI assistance.
features.symptomGuidanceDesc: Answer simple questions about how you feel to get clear next-step suggestions and know when to seek urgent care.
features.availabilityDesc: Access health assessments anytime — start a symptom check or review resources whenever you need them.
features.secureRecordsDesc: Your medical history, consultations, and referrals are stored securely with role-based access control.

features.smartReferralsDesc: Automated referral system to RHUs and hospitals with complete patient information for continuity of care.

triage.sectionDescription: Your answers are grouped into care levels so you can see what kind of follow-up may fit. This is guidance only — not a medical diagnosis.
triage.emergencyDesc: Immediate medical attention required. Life-threatening conditions.
triage.emergencyExamples: Chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, loss of consciousness
triage.urgentDesc: Needs attention within hours. Significant symptoms requiring prompt care.
triage.urgentExamples: High fever, moderate pain, persistent vomiting, suspected fractures
triage.nonUrgentDesc: Can wait for scheduled consultation. Mild symptoms without immediate risk.
triage.nonUrgentExamples: Minor cold, skin rashes, mild headaches, follow-up consultations
triage.homeCareDesc: Self-care with guidance. Conditions manageable at home with proper advice.
triage.homeCareExamples: Common cold, minor cuts, rest and hydration cases

about.headline: Bringing Quality Healthcare
about.description: We serve Barangay Abangay with a mission to bridge the healthcare gap through innovative technology, AI-assisted triage, and strong partnerships with local health workers and the rural health unit.
about.missionDesc: To make quality healthcare accessible to every Filipino, especially those in rural and underserved communities, by leveraging technology to connect patients with healthcare providers and empowering local health workers.
about.visionDesc: A Philippines where geographic location and economic status are no longer barriers to quality healthcare. We envision a future where every barangay has access to modern telehealth services supported by AI and local health workers.
about.challengeDesc: Rural communities in the Philippines face significant barriers to accessing quality healthcare.
about.geographicDesc: Many rural residents must travel long distances to reach the nearest health center or hospital, often requiring expensive transportation and time away from work.
about.limitedDesc: Rural health units and barangay health centers often have limited staff, equipment, and supplies to serve their communities effectively.
about.delayedDesc: Without proper triage, patients may delay seeking care or seek care at inappropriate levels, leading to worse health outcomes.
about.infoGapsDesc: Patients often lack information about when to seek care, what symptoms are concerning, and how to access available health services.
about.valuesDesc: These principles guide everything we do and every decision we make.
about.compassionDesc: We believe healthcare is a fundamental right. Every person deserves access to quality medical care, regardless of where they live.
about.trustPrivacyDesc: Your health data is sacred. We implement the highest security standards to protect your personal information and medical records.
about.innovationDesc: We leverage cutting-edge AI technology to make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and effective for rural communities.
about.communityDesc: We work with local health workers, barangay officials, and community members to ensure our solutions meet real needs.
about.impactDesc: Making a difference in communities across the Philippines
about.partnersDesc: TeleHealth for Barangay Abangay is made possible through partnerships with:
about.bhwPartnerDesc: Our frontline partners who conduct assessments and provide community health services.
about.rhuPartnerDesc: Local health facilities that provide consultations and coordinate referrals to hospitals.
about.communityPartnerDesc: Barangay officials and community organizations that help us reach and serve residents.
about.joinDesc: Whether you are a resident, health worker, or community leader in Barangay Abangay, there is a place for you in our mission to make healthcare accessible for all.
